name: F-Keys for Orca
description: Twelve account slots: Alt+F1 to Alt+F12, the palette or the sidebar panel open a new terminal tab in the focused workspace that runs the slot’s own command, such as an agent CLI on its own account profile.

statusBarItems.tooltip: F-Keys for Orca: list the slots

settings.title: Slot 1 label
settings.description: Name shown in the panel and used as the new terminal title (Alt+F1).

settings.title: Slot 1 command
settings.description: Command the new terminal runs in the workspace host’s shell, e.g. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-work claude. Empty turns the slot off.
